name: Objects as Characters
description: Personified everyday objects and animated constructs. Entries describe the character's physical features rather than requiring speech or a mood.
entries: walking grandfather clock with carved wooden feet
animated umbrella with jointed ribs and eyes on its canopy
potted cactus with a face between its spines
ink bottle with glass arms and a hinged cap
accordion with eyes above its expanding bellows
chest with a carved face and sturdy wooden legs
candle with a face molded below its flame
ceramic bowl with small feet around its base
mailbox with eyes above its hinged slot
sewing machine with articulated feet and a face on its casing
traffic cone with a face and flexible striped arms
origami crane with drawn eyes and folded paper legs
teapot with a face molded into its round body
living sword with eyes set into its guard
toaster with a face on its front panel
walking lantern with hinged metal legs
clockwork book with small jointed arms
stone statue with flexible joints and worn carved features
watering can with a face beneath its spout
rolling suitcase with eyes above its front pocket
